cases.goal: Make the eval regex scorer handle invalid regular expressions as a failed ScoreResult instead of raising. Retain the caller's threshold and explain the invalid pattern. Preserve valid matches, misses, event-type filtering and unknown-event handling. Add regression tests.

Make EvalReport passed/failed counts derive from its current results. Construct reports with session_id, results and config, without separately supplied counts. Appending, replacing or removing results must immediately update counts and overall_passed. Keep run_eval and JSON report formatting working and add regression tests.

Ensure the live watcher's CostWatcher emits a cost-limit violation only once per WatchState. Additional cost increases, including crossing whole-dollar boundaries, must not re-alert. A new WatchState should alert independently and retry/duration watchers must keep working. Add regression tests.

Store Claude and Copilot hook traces beneath an existing absolute directory supplied by payload cwd, even when the hook process runs from an installed plugin directory. Explicit AGENT_TRACE_DIR must retain precedence. Missing, relative, non-directory or non-string cwd must fall back safely to process cwd. The selected directory must not leak into a later hook invocation. Add regression tests.

Fix generated portable cache-audit verifier package discovery for evidence bundles nested below their source repository. Skip ancestor candidates with no regular llmtracefx package, including a symlinked package, and continue searching. Preserve digest matching, explicit --package-root behavior, source snapshotting and failure when no matching source exists. Add regression tests.
